name: rc-lead-finder
description: Watches your neighbourhood on Nextdoor and Facebook groups: leads, competitors, and services people are asking for.
long_description: A weekly or daily look at your own neighbourhood, using your own Chrome through Claude in Chrome. It finds people asking for your services, shows what competitors are posting and charging, notices demand triggers like storms or HOA letters, and tracks services neighbours ask for that you don't offer yet. Everything lands on a local dashboard with a written summary. It reads only — it never posts, comments, messages, or joins anything. Setup is an interview in chat, and it can put itself on a Claude Desktop schedule.
